name: Notion
description: Notion combines documents, databases, project tracking, and team knowledge in one flexible workspace.
best_for: Positioned for teams of any size, from startups to large enterprises, who want people and AI working together in one connected workspace.
features: Built-in calendar and third-party app connections

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: For individuals and small teams; includes collaborative workspaces, up to 10 guests, and 7-day page history.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $8/seat/mo (or $10/seat/mo monthly); adds unlimited blocks for teams, unlimited file uploads, 30-day page history, and up to 100 guests.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $15/seat/mo (or $18/seat/mo monthly); adds SAML SSO, private teamspaces, 90-day page history, and up to 250 guests.

pros: Versatile modular block architecture combining rich documents, team wikis, and relational databases in one view
Aesthetic design with thousands of community-built templates and flexible page layouts
Generous free plan for individuals and small team collaborative workspaces
cons: Nested database queries and relations can slow down navigation in massive organizational workspaces
Granular permission inheritance across sub-pages requires deliberate organizational design
Notion AI features require a separate paid add-on ($8/member/month)

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A project-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need structured project management

alternatives.name: Coda
alternatives.description: A collaborative document platform that combines text, tables, formulas, and app-like workflows.

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: A team knowledge-management platform designed for documentation and internal collaboration.

alternatives.name: Dropbox
alternatives.description: A cloud file-sync and content platform for shared folders, links, version recovery, large-file transfer, and team administration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that mainly need dependable file sync, sharing, recovery, and storage instead of a document-and-database workspace.
